messages:
Sasha (growth): Quick sync — planning a micro-journey experiment for new signups. Idea: 20-min webinar + 50 free credits + 3 curated prompt templates. Metric goal: lift first-10-requests conversion from ~12% -> 18%. Thoughts?

Arman (content): Sounds good. Can we split by persona (dev vs PM)? Recommend two prompt packs: "starter code helper" and "product spec buddy". Keep copy <140 chars.

Priya (growth): +1 on personas. Cohort filter proposal: signup_age <= 14d, no previous requests, region in US/CA. Sequence: Day 0 credit grant, Day 2 nudge + promptpack, Day 4 webinar invite, Day 7 final nudge. Cap credits to first 500 users.

Theo (analytics): I'll add instrumentation. Please include UTM (utm_campaign=microjourney_q2) and experiment id. Baseline metrics: first-10-requests conv = 12.3%, avg tokens per session 450, retention@7 = 9.8%. Target: +5.7pp conv, lift retention to 12%.

Jules (events): I can host the webinar Thu 11am PT. 20-min demo (how to ship a prompt pack) + 15 Q&A. Landing page + register flow I can spin up. Need slides and prompt examples by Monday.

Sasha (growth): OK. Budget: 50 credits/user, 500-user cap. A/B test copy: control (generic invite) vs explicit (calls out prompt templates + credit). Track: conversion -> activated (10 requests), DAU7, cost-per-activated. @Theo can you confirm tracking events?

playbook-bot: Created playbook: microjourney-credit-hook -> /playbooks/microjourney-credit-hook (owner: Sasha).

Arman (content): Draft subject lines for emails/register flow:
- "Try Redwood: 50 credits + 20-min workshop"
- "Ship an LLM feature in 20 minutes — we give the prompts"

Arman (content): Draft prompt templates (short):
```
1) Starter code helper:
"Generate a TypeScript function that validates emails and returns a user-friendly error message."

2) Product spec buddy:
"Write a 6-bullet spec for a feature that summarizes meeting notes into action items."

3) Cold-email generator:
"Draft a 3-line outreach email for hiring a senior ML engineer, tone: direct, friendly."
```

Priya (growth): I'll create the experiment in GA and the cohort in Posthog. Also adding an onboarding flow variant that surfaces the prompt pack on first open.

Sasha (growth): Great. Action items: @Arman finalize copy & prompt pack (Mon EOD), @Jules landing + reg (Tue), @Theo add tracking & dashboards (Wed), @Priya create cohorts & experiments (Tue). Review cycle: I'll approve copy by EOD today. :thumbsup:

Jules (events): Noted. I'll build the landing and calendar, and set up automated reminder emails.

Theo (analytics): Will add dashboard widgets for cohort and experiment. Sending schema in thread.

Priya (growth): Launch window suggestion: next Thu (one week out). That gives needed runway for assets.

Sasha (growth): Agreed. Thanks team — we'll reconvene Mon after copy review.
